# Redbay Group

> Redbay Construction Ltd is an NCA Category 7 building contractor registered with the National Construction Authority of Kenya, based in Ruaraka, Nairobi. Redbay Group builds homes, schools, perimeter walls and interiors, and installs solar and wind power, across Kenya.

## Contact

- Phone and WhatsApp: +254 725 546 059
- Email: hello@redbaygroup.co.ke
- WhatsApp link: https://wa.me/254725546059
- Office: Ruaraka, Nairobi, Kenya
- Contact page: https://redbaygroup.co.ke/contact/

## Pricing

- Quotes are itemised bills of quantities with one fixed price, quoted before VAT.
- Perimeter walls: from KSh 14,000 per running metre for a wall 2.4 m high on a foundation 0.8 m deep, before VAT; gate priced separately.
- [Perimeter wall cost calculator](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/perimeter-wall-calculator/): instant estimate from the boundary length.
- [Construction Knowledge Hub](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/): guides by topic, from building costs to roofing, materials and finishes.
- [Capability statement](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/capability-statement/): registration, insurance, process and selected work for institutions, with a one-page PDF.
- [Building materials calculator](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/building-materials-calculator/): how many blocks, bags of cement, sand and ballast a job needs.
- [Solar and wind hybrid systems](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/hybrid-solar-wind-systems/): check whether wind makes sense at your site; design and installation by Redbay Energy.
- [Build in Kenya from abroad](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/build-in-kenya-from-abroad/): drawings, BoQ, managed build and inspections for Kenyans living abroad.
- [Contractor checklist](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/contractor-checklist/): 10 questions to ask before hiring a building contractor, with a PDF.
- [Roofing sheets calculator](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/roofing-sheets-calculator/): how many iron sheets a roof needs.
- [House cost calculator](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/house-cost-calculator/): published Nairobi cost per square metre for a house.
- [Bill of quantities service](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/bill-of-quantities-service/): itemised BoQ prepared from your drawings; fee quoted before starting.
- [Get a quote](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/get-a-quote/): short form that opens WhatsApp with project details.

## Specialised services

- [Architectural and structural drawings](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/services/drawings/): Architectural and structural drawings by Redbay, an NCA-registered contractor, for building approval. An architect signs where required.
- [Waterproofing](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/services/waterproofing/): Waterproofing by Redbay, an NCA-registered contractor: flat roofs, balconies, bathrooms, water tanks, basements and damp walls, new or existing.
- [Roofing](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/services/roofing/): Roofing by Redbay, an NCA-registered contractor: new roofs, re-roofing and roof repairs for homes and schools, built to your drawings across Kenya.
- [Project management](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/services/project-management/): Project management by Redbay, an NCA-registered contractor: programme, budget, site supervision and progress reports for homes, schools and fit-outs.
- [Site audits and inspection](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/services/site-audits/): Site audits and inspections by Redbay, an NCA-registered contractor: we check work against drawings and BoQs, and report what needs fixing.
- [Site setup](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/services/site-setup/): Site setup by Redbay, an NCA-registered contractor: site house, toilet, CCTV security and perimeter walling, so your build starts organised and safe.
- [Property maintenance](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/services/property-maintenance/): Property maintenance by Redbay, an NCA-registered contractor: inspections and repairs for homes, rentals, schools and offices, before small faults grow.

## Companies

- [Redbay Construction](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/companies/construction/): Residential construction and development, delivering quality homes built for durability, functionality and modern living.
- [Redbay Schools](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/companies/schools/): Developing functional, inspiring and adaptable educational infrastructure for schools and learning institutions.
- [Redbay Interiors](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/companies/interiors/): Transforming spaces through thoughtful design, quality finishes and functional interior solutions.
- [Redbay Energy](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/companies/energy/): Delivering solar and wind energy solutions for homes, institutions and developments.

- [Building contractor in Nairobi, Kiambu and Machakos](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/nairobi/): Ruaraka, Karen, Kamulu, Ruai, Kikuyu, Lukenya, Tala, Kangundo, Athi River, Syokimau, Juja, Ruiru
- [Building contractor in Diani, Ukunda and the Kenyan coast](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/coast/): Diani, Ukunda, Galu, Tiwi, Msambweni, Mombasa, Kilifi
- [School and home construction in Kajiado](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/kajiado/): Isinya, Kitengela, Kajiado town, Ongata Rongai, Kiserian

- [Building contractor in Kakamega and Western Kenya](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/locations/kakamega/): Kakamega town, Lurambi, Shinyalu, Malava, Mumias, Butere

## Projects

- [Merishaw School, Isinya, Kajiado](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/merishaw-school/): Classroom blocks for Merishaw School in Isinya, built around a courtyard, from foundations to the concrete frame, steel roofing and finishes.
- [Maisonette, Baraka Estate, Nanyuki](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/nanyuki-baraka-home/): A family maisonette in Baraka Estate, Nanyuki, built from walling to the final coat of paint, with tiled floors and a cabro driveway.
- [Four-bedroom home, Lukenya, Machakos](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/lukenya-four-bedroom/): A modern four-bedroom home in Lukenya, built from the foundations up, with a stone-clad facade, balconies and steel windows.
- [5-bedroom maisonette, Kibwezi, Makueni](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/kibwezi-maisonette/): A two-storey, five-bedroom home in Kibwezi, Makueni, built from foundations to a hip-and-gable roof in black stone-coated tiles, with plastered outside walls.
- [Bungalow, Oljororok, Nyahururu](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/oljororok-bungalow/): Shell works for a bungalow in Oljororok, Nyahururu: slab, block walls, ring beam, timber roof and yellow stone cladding.
- [Two-storey home, Kamulu, Nairobi](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/kamulu-roofing-shell/): Shell works and roofing for a two-storey family home in Kamulu, with a machine-cut stone ground floor, balconies and a red stone-coated tile roof.
- [Two-storey home, Kericho](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/kericho-roofing/): Steel roof structure and red stone-coated tile roofing for a two-storey stone and block home in Kericho, with hips, gables and a rounded corner bay.
- [Bungalow, Tala, Kangundo](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/tala-bungalow-shell/): Shell works for a family bungalow in Tala, Kangundo: stone foundation, block walls, ring beam, steel roof trusses and grey stone-coated tiles.
- [Maisonette, Diani, Kwale](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/diani-maisonette/): A five-bedroom coastal maisonette between Ukunda and Diani, with coral stone cladding, smoked glass balconies and timber pergolas on the roof.
- [Thatched gazebo, Diani, Kwale](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/diani-gazebo/): A traditional makuti-thatched gazebo in Diani on concrete columns and a raised coral stone base, with built-in wiring, low walls and a tiled floor.
- [Family bungalow, Kakamega](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/kakamega-bungalow/): A family bungalow in Kakamega built from setting out to a finished hipped roof, with block walls, a front veranda, steel windows and a solar water heater.
- [Office interiors, Cyber 1, Nairobi](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/projects/cyber1-office-interiors/): Redecoration of the reception and waiting area at Cyber 1's Nairobi offices: navy feature walls, painted ceiling bulkheads and fresh white walls and ceilings.

## Guides

- [Flat roof leaking? Causes and lasting fixes](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/flat-roof-leaking-causes-and-fixes/): Why concrete flat roofs leak in Kenya, how to find where water gets in, and the repairs and waterproofing that stop leaks for good, not just until the rains.
- [Bathroom waterproofing before tiling: why it matters](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/bathroom-waterproofing-before-tiling/): Tiles and grout are not waterproof. How bathrooms and showers should be waterproofed before tiling, and the signs that water is already leaking through.
- [Waterproofing concrete and masonry water tanks](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/water-tank-waterproofing/): How to waterproof underground and raised concrete or masonry water tanks so they hold water, stay clean and do not leak into the ground or the building.
- [Waterproofing methods compared: which one do you need?](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/choosing-a-waterproofing-method/): Torch-on membranes, liquid membranes, cementitious coatings and crystalline treatments compared: where each works best on roofs, bathrooms, tanks and basements.
- [Balcony and roof terrace leaks: how to stop them](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/balcony-and-terrace-leaks/): Why balconies and roof terraces leak into the rooms below, and the drainage, falls and waterproofing under the tiles that keep them dry.
- [Basement and retaining wall waterproofing](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/basement-and-retaining-wall-waterproofing/): How water gets into basements and below-ground rooms, and the waterproofing and drainage that keep retaining walls and basements dry on sloping Kenyan plots.
- [Building on black cotton soil in Kenya](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/building-on-black-cotton-soil/): Why black cotton soil cracks houses and walls, how to spot it on your plot, and the foundations that keep a building sound in Kajiado, Machakos and Nairobi.
- [How to read a bill of quantities (BoQ)](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/how-to-read-a-bill-of-quantities/): A plain guide to the bill of quantities: what the columns mean, how the work is grouped, and the questions to ask before you accept a building quote in Kenya.
- [Damp walls and waterproofing: causes and fixes](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/damp-and-waterproofing/): Why walls get damp, how to tell rising damp from leaks and condensation, and the waterproofing that stops it in new and existing Kenyan homes.
- [Septic tank or biodigester: which suits your home?](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/septic-tank-or-biodigester/): How septic tanks and biodigesters work, the pros and cons of each, soakaways, approvals and upkeep, for Kenyan homes without a sewer connection.
- [Rainwater harvesting for homes and schools](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/rainwater-harvesting-for-homes/): How to collect and store rainwater in Kenya: roofs, gutters, first-flush diverters, tank sizing and keeping stored water clean for homes and schools.
- [Planning a kitchen that works: a Kenyan guide](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/planning-a-kitchen/): Kitchen layouts, worktops, cabinets, ventilation, lighting and sockets: how to plan a practical kitchen for a Kenyan home before the walls are finished.
- [Office renovation in Kenya: a planning guide](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/office-renovation-guide/): How to plan an office fit-out in Kenya: layout, glass partitions, ceilings and lighting, power and data, working around staff, and the right order of works.
- [Cost of building a house per square metre in Kenya](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/cost-of-building-a-house-per-square-metre-kenya/): Published building costs per square metre in Kenya for bungalows and maisonettes, what they include, and why your own figure will differ.
- [Gypsum ceiling cost in Kenya per square metre](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/gypsum-ceiling-cost-kenya/): Typical gypsum ceiling prices in Kenya per square metre, supplied and fixed, by design, what is left out, and how to price your own rooms.
- [Septic tank and biodigester cost in Kenya](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/septic-tank-cost-kenya/): Typical costs in Kenya for a concrete septic tank, a plastic tank and a biodigester, what each includes, and what pushes the price up.
- [Common construction mistakes in Kenya to avoid](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/common-construction-mistakes-kenya/): The construction mistakes that cost Kenyan homeowners most: no drawings, vague quotations, unchecked contractors, ignored soil and late waterproofing.
- [Building in Kenya from abroad: avoid being cheated](https://redbaygroup.co.ke/insights/build-a-house-in-kenya-from-abroad-safely/): How Kenyans abroad can build safely back home: check the land, get drawings and a priced BoQ, pay by stage and use independent inspections.

## Frequently asked questions

### What do you build?

Family homes, from bungalows to maisonettes, school buildings, perimeter walls and outdoor structures such as gazebos. Redbay Interiors fits out homes and offices, and Redbay Energy installs solar and wind power. We also offer specialised services: architectural and structural drawings, bills of quantities, waterproofing, roofing, site setup, project management, site audits and inspections, and property maintenance.

### Where in Kenya do you work?

We are based in Ruaraka, Nairobi. We have built in Nairobi (including Karen and Kamulu), Kiambu (Kikuyu), Machakos (Lukenya and Tala), Makueni (Kibwezi), Kajiado (Isinya), Laikipia (Nanyuki), Nyandarua (Oljororok, Nyahururu), Nakuru, Kakamega and Kwale (Diani and Ukunda). Tell us where your site is and we will confirm.

### Are you a licensed contractor?

Yes. Redbay Construction Ltd is registered with the National Construction Authority (NCA) as a Category 7 contractor.

### Are your projects insured?

Yes. We hold Contractor’s All Risk insurance on our projects.

### How do you price a project?

We measure the work into an itemised bill of quantities, then give you one fixed quotation with the scope, timeline and payment stages written down. Prices are quoted before VAT.

### How much does a perimeter wall cost?

From KSh 14,000 per running metre for a wall 2.4 metres high on a foundation 0.8 metres deep, before VAT. The gate is priced separately. Our perimeter wall calculator gives an instant estimate, and we confirm the exact rate after seeing the site.

### What should I send to get a quote?

Your drawings if you have them, the site location, a few photos of the site, and when you would like to start. If you do not have drawings yet, tell us what you want to build and we will advise on next steps.

### Do you build from my architect’s drawings?

Yes. We build to the approved drawings and work with your architect and engineer during construction. If you are still choosing a design, our home designs page shows concept designs we can build for you, adapted to your plot and budget.

### Can I build in phases?

Yes. Many clients build the foundation, walls and roof first and do the finishes later, as funds allow. We price each phase separately in the bill of quantities and plan the order of work so each stage is protected from the weather and nothing has to be broken out later.

### Can you do only part of a project?

Yes. As well as complete builds, we take on parts of a project: shell and roofing works only, finishes and interiors only, or a perimeter wall on its own.

### Do you renovate offices?

Yes. Redbay Interiors fits out offices with glass partitions, boardrooms, suspended ceilings and LED lighting, built-in cabinets and painting. We can work in the evenings and at weekends, so your office keeps running during the renovation.
